text_blocks.snippet: To help someone cope with depression, offer consistent support, encourage professional help, and gently suggest healthy lifestyle changes. Be patient, understanding, and remind them of their positive qualities and value.

list.title: Be a good listener:
list.snippet: Create a safe space for them to share their feelings without judgment.

list.title: Encourage professional help:
list.snippet: Suggest they consult a doctor or therapist. Offer to help them find resources or even go with them to an appointment.

list.title: Promote healthy habits:
list.snippet: Gently encourage physical activity, balanced nutrition, and sufficient sleep.
